scripts.dev:local: cross-env NODE_ENV=development TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.server.json DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/true_webhook JWT_SECRET=local-dev-secret-change-me PORT=3000 BASE_DOMAIN=localhost DISABLE_BALANCE_WORKER=true LOCAL_JGA88_MODE=true ts-node-dev --respawn --transpile-only --ignore-watch .next src/server.ts
scripts.start:local: cross-env NODE_ENV=production DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/true_webhook JWT_SECRET=local-dev-secret-change-me PORT=3000 BASE_DOMAIN=localhost DISABLE_BALANCE_WORKER=true LOCAL_JGA88_MODE=true node dist/server.js
scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate && next build && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json
scripts.start:master: cross-env APP_ROOT=master NODE_ENV=production npm run start:railway
scripts.start:tenant: cross-env APP_ROOT=tenant NODE_ENV=production npm run start:railway
